div.head: III Atr 7
div.ab: And gif hwa þeof clænsian wylle, lecge an C to wedde, healf landrican ⁊ healf cinges gerefan binnan port, ⁊ gange to þrimfealdan ordale.
Et si quis furem innoxiare uelit, ponat unum hundretum in uadio, dimidium tunc domino, dimidium preposito regis intra portum, et adeat triplex ordalium.
And gif hwa þeof clænsian wylle, lecge an C to wedde, healf landrican ⁊ healf cinges gerefan binnan port, ⁊ gange to þrimfealdan ordale.
And if anyone seeks to clear a thief, he shall deposit 100 [of silver] as security, half with the lord of the manor and half with the king's town-reeve and he shall go to the triple ordeal.

Und wenn jemand einen [hingerichteten] Dieb als rein erweisen will, so hinterlege er Ein Hundert [Silbers] als Pfand, halb dem Immunitätsherrn und halb dem Königsvogt innerhalb der [fürs Ordal zuständigen Gerichts]stadt, und schreite zu dreifachem Ordale.

And if anyone wishes to prove an [executed] thief innocent, let him deposit one hundred [of silver] as a pledge, half to the lord of the immunity and half to the king's reeve within the [court-]town [responsible for the ordeal], and go to the threefold ordeal.
